entries.title: Listing photo and contact bar shook while scrolling
entries.problem: The photo depth effect set a CSS variable on <body> and re-blurred a full-screen layer every scroll frame, starving the compositor, so the photo and the fixed contact pill jittered on iPhone.
entries.fix: Depth now changes transform/opacity only, on the hero alone; the backdrop blur is constant; the contact pill sits on its own layer.
entries.rule: Never drive per-frame effects through <body> variables or animate filter/blur on scroll. Only transform and opacity.

entries.title: Bottom sheets bounced past their edge
entries.problem: The shared spring overshot by 56%, so sheets slid past rest and showed a gap at the screen edge, and cards bounced.
entries.fix: Sheets and modals use an expo-out curve with no overshoot; only small controls keep a soft spring; --v3-spring was softened globally.
entries.rule: Large surfaces (sheets, modals, the dock, cards) never use an overshooting curve. Overshoot is for chips and buttons only.

entries.title: Minimized bar columns snapped instead of animating
entries.problem: hybrid.css set its own transition list and dropped grid-template-columns, so the dock columns snapped while the height animated.
entries.fix: motion.css owns one transition list for every dock property, including grid-template-columns, left and right.
entries.rule: Any rule that sets `transition` on .mob-nav must include every property that changes between the expanded and compact states.

entries.title: Highlighted tab was cut off in the minimized bar
entries.problem: The gold pill for the active tab was wider than its grid column and was clipped at the bar edge, off-centre.
entries.fix: The active tab's column grows (1.75fr) to hold its pill, via :has(); the bar has side padding.
entries.rule: The minimized bar must keep a column for the active pill; never fix a clipped pill by hiding overflow.

entries.title: Pressing Home on Home did nothing / the logo reloaded the page
entries.problem: goHome returned early when already on Home (no scroll, filters stuck), and the logo link followed href="/" and reloaded the whole page.
entries.fix: goHome prevents the default on plain taps, clears filters, rebuilds the feed and scrolls to the top (smooth unless reduced-motion).
entries.rule: The logo stays a real <a href="/"> but a plain tap is always handled in-app. Pressing Home when on Home scrolls to top.

entries.title: Bell showed nothing for unread notifications
entries.problem: The home bell had no unread indicator.
entries.fix: A red badge with the unread count (9+ above nine), refreshed on load, new chats, tab focus and opening Notifications.
entries.rule: The bell badge is driven by v3UnreadNotifs(); do not replace it with a boolean dot.

entries.title: New notifications were easy to miss
entries.problem: A new message only produced a plain toast.
entries.fix: On phones a centred glass card rises, then curves into the bell, which rings and bumps its badge.
entries.rule: Phone notifications use v3Notify (centred card that returns to the bell); plain toasts are desktop-only.

entries.title: A failed mark-as-read write blocked the chat from opening
entries.problem: sbMarkRead threw (no database / offline) before renderChat ran, so the thread never opened.
entries.fix: The write is fire-and-forget inside try/catch with a rejection handler.
entries.rule: Background writes must never be awaited or allowed to throw in the path that opens a screen.

entries.title: Member-supplied names/titles reached innerHTML
entries.problem: A hostile display name or ad title executed as HTML inside the chat.
entries.fix: Every member-supplied string is escaped with escHtml before it enters markup.
entries.rule: Never put a name, title or message into innerHTML without escHtml. test-msg-v2 drives a hostile payload.

entries.title: Buyer-feedback script must not build markup from strings
entries.problem: A change used innerHTML in js/ad-feedback.js; the security test rejects that and CI went red.
entries.fix: The Google button and its logo are built with createElement/createElementNS.
entries.rule: js/ad-feedback.js never uses innerHTML or localStorage (member text goes in through textContent only).

entries.title: Buyer join card was crowded
entries.problem: The join card showed Google, a dropdown and three fields at once.
entries.fix: A full-width Continue with Google button with the Google logo; email is behind "Use email instead".
entries.rule: The primary action on the join card is Google. The email form stays collapsed by default.

entries.title: Two footers on phones
entries.problem: The SEO "About Yaad Adz" block and the real footer both showed as separate heavy sections.
entries.fix: On phones the About text folds into the footer as small centred text; category links are hidden. It stays in the page for search engines.
entries.rule: Never delete .seo-about (it is crawlable SEO content); fold it visually instead.

entries.title: Gas pill and AI orb overlapped the nav bar
entries.problem: The old floating gas banner and AI orb sat on top of the bottom bar.
entries.fix: They are hidden on phones; gas price and Ask live in the dock strip (js/dock.js).
entries.rule: Do not re-show #gasBanner / .v3-ai-float on phones. The dock strip replaces them.

guards.text: html body #gasBanner, html body .v3-ai-float { display: none !important; }

entries.title: AI icon was cut off at the bar corner
entries.problem: The equaliser orb touched the right edge of the dock and was clipped by its rounded corner.
entries.fix: A typing chat bubble with right padding on the strip; animation pauses while scrolling and for reduced motion.
entries.rule: Keep padding-right on .hy-strip so the Ask control clears the corner radius.

entries.title: Bottom bar floated above the iPhone keyboard
entries.problem: With the keyboard open the nav and back-to-top button rode above it.
entries.fix: html.kb-open hides the nav and the back-to-top button.
entries.rule: Keep the kb-open rules for the dock and back-to-top.

entries.title: New CSS/JS not available offline
entries.problem: Files not added to sw.js precache were missing for offline/PWA users.
entries.fix: hybrid.css, motion.css, js/dock.js and js/build.js are precached.
entries.rule: Every new CSS/JS file must be added to the sw.js precache list and CACHE_VERSION bumped.

entries.title: Motion ignored the reduced-motion setting
entries.problem: Decorative loops and slides kept running for people who asked for less motion.
entries.fix: A reduced-motion block removes transitions, entrance animations and decorative loops.
entries.rule: New animation must be covered by the prefers-reduced-motion block in motion.css.

entries.title: Small controls animated every property
entries.problem: `transition: all` on small controls animated layout properties and wasted frames.
entries.fix: Replaced with explicit property lists.
entries.rule: Do not add `transition: all .15s/.2s` to small controls; list the properties.

entries.title: Old builds could come back from a stale cache
entries.problem: A stale service-worker cache or CDN edge could serve an older build, silently resurrecting fixed problems.
entries.fix: js/build.js remembers the highest build this browser has run and refreshes once if an older one appears.
entries.rule: js/build.js must remain the first script in index.html and stay precached.

entries.title: Smoke Test was red for weeks
entries.problem: The photo-gesture test needs @supabase/supabase-js but the workflow never installed dependencies, so every later step was skipped.
entries.fix: The workflow runs npm ci --ignore-scripts, and the missing test:home script exists.
entries.rule: Every CI step must reference a script that exists; install dependencies before running tests.
